recovery.cause: The Cloudflare Workers Free account-wide request quota had been exhausted before forty other tenant domains were moved to direct origin.
recovery.reset: Cloudflare reset the daily quota at 00:00 UTC on 2026-08-29.
recovery.trafficReduction: Only the two YDA domains remain on the dedicated YDA Worker; the other forty tenant domains now bypass Workers.
recovery.result: Both apex English homepages recovered to 200 and both www hosts recovered to the expected single 308 redirect.

checks.reviewedPages: All 12 reviewed sitemap pages return 200 with exact self-canonicals, index/follow metadata, unique titles and descriptions, structured data and matching sitemap inclusion.
checks.visual: Both domains passed desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 production checks with no overflow, broken images, page errors, console errors or bad HTTP responses.
checks.duplicateContent: The maximum five-word homepage shingle similarity is 0.4751, below the 0.60 release threshold.
checks.robots: The default crawler and Googlebot blocks allow the root, restrict only private and unreviewed routes, and publish the exact domain sitemap.
checks.assets: Both favicons return 200 as image/svg+xml and the rendered pages contain no broken images.
checks.rsc: Five independently probed YDA Express .org React Server Component prefetch endpoints return 200 as text/x-component. A transient first-pass Chromium network suspension did not reproduce in the confirmed audit.
checks.mainSiteIsolation: The IndexFinds main site and API remained healthy throughout recovery and validation.

operationalNote: The current YDA service remains subject to the Workers Free 100,000-request daily account limit. Direct-origin preparation is retained as a future hardening option but is not a current production blocker while only these two domains invoke Workers.

rollback.routeAction: Restore the four exact apex/www route IDs using yda-route-rollback-20260827.json if the dedicated YDA Worker must be reverted.
rollback.originPreparation: The unused HTTP-only Hostinger vhosts, restricted private keys and unsigned CSRs remain isolated until DNS Edit and Origin CA permissions are available.
